messages:
Ava (growth): Quick pulse — we ran the calculator AB last week where we renamed "Committed" -> "Reserved" on the tier picker. Can we get a quick summary before the all-hands tomorrow?

Luis (analytics): Baseline: control (Committed) CTR -> plan page = 3.1%, conversion to trial starts = 0.62%. Variant (Reserved) CTR = 3.9%, trial starts = 0.95%. Sample N ~ 9k. p<0.05 for CTR, borderline for trial starts.

Maya (content): Nice! Thoughts on messaging: "Reserved" sounds more enterprise-y. We should update FAQ line: "What does Reserved mean?" to be more specific about SLA and billing. Suggested copy: 

Sam (design): +1. Also spotted topo issue on mobile calc: the tier selector wraps weirdly after the label change.

Diego (product): Good catch. Can we try two follow-ups: 1) FAQ update and 2) microcopy tweak under the tier label — shorter helper text. Quick experiment matrix:
- Variant A: rename + FAQ update
- Variant B: rename + helper copy change
- Variant C: rename + both

Ava (growth): Love it. Timeline?

Luis (analytics): We can stop the experiment early if effect strong. Recommend 7 days to collect another ~20k impressions. I'll set tracking for events: planner_cta_click, start_trial, faq_open.

Maya (content): Drafts for FAQ and helper copy:
- FAQ Q: "What does Reserved capacity mean?" A: "Reserved capacity gives you dedicated inference pools with guaranteed throughput, priority scheduling, and single-tenant billing. Ideal for predictable latency and compliance needs."
- Helper copy: "Reserved — dedicated GPUs, SLA-backed performance"

Sam (design): I'll push a small CSS fix for mobile wrapping and update the tier label length to avoid line breaks. Will create a 5-min deploy PR.

Diego (product): Can engineering add a metric to indicate support ticket rate for customers who view the FAQ? Might be useful for downstream. @eng-oncall FYI.

Ava (growth): Can marketing ops add a 1-question microsurvey for users who use the calc: "Did this pricing description match what you expected? (Yes/No)" — to be shown after calc interaction.

Maya (content): If they say No, show a short free-text optional box: "What were you expecting?" Keep it optional.

Luis (analytics): I'll wire microsurvey event. Suggest sampling 10% to not bias conversion.

Sam (design): Microsurvey overlay mock attached in PR. (link) — will keep it non-blocking.

Ava (growth): Great. Action items: Luis -> set up events + target sample; Sam -> PR for mobile + microsurvey UI; Maya -> push FAQ + helper copy; Diego -> add metric for faq->support linkage. I'll follow up in #marketing tomorrow with initial numbers.

DevBot: deploy request queued by Sam — PR #4123

Ava (growth): :thumbsup: Thanks team, this feels safe to roll. Keep updates in this thread.
